title: 50 storey residential tower, Brisbane CBD: piling
workplace: 50 storey residential tower with foyer and 3 level basement carpark, Brisbane CBD
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Piling rig delivery, assembly and working platforms
swms.task: Deliver, assemble and dismantle the CFA and bored piling rigs, and build and maintain the piling working platform in the basement excavation.

facts.pilingPlatform: The working platform is designed by the project geotechnical engineer for the 90 t CFA rig and the 100 t bored pile rig, with a maximum plant loading of 250 kPa. The platform certificate is given to each rig operator before the rig goes on it.

steps: Deliver, assemble and dismantle the rig

swms.title: CFA piling
swms.task: Drill and install CFA piles for the tower foundations with the CFA piling rig, pumping concrete through the auger and placing the reinforcement cages with our service crawler crane.

facts.pilingPlatform: The working platform is designed by the project geotechnical engineer for the 90 t CFA rig and the 100 t bored pile rig, with a maximum plant loading of 250 kPa. The platform certificate is given to each rig operator before the rig goes on it.
facts.craneChart: Service crawler crane rated capacity chart: 8 t at 12 m radius. Heaviest gross load is a 4.5 t cage with spreader bar and slings (4.8 t gross) at 10 m radius.

steps: Lift, pitch and lower reinforcement cages

swms.title: Bored piles, open bores and cages
swms.task: Drill bored piles up to 25 m deep for the tower core, lift and lower the reinforcement cages into the open bores with our service crawler crane, and place concrete by tremie.

facts.pilingPlatform: The working platform is designed by the project geotechnical engineer for the 90 t CFA rig and the 100 t bored pile rig, with a maximum plant loading of 250 kPa. The platform certificate is given to each rig operator before the rig goes on it.
facts.craneChart: Service crawler crane rated capacity chart: 8 t at 12 m radius. Heaviest gross load is a 6.2 t cage with spreader bar and slings (6.5 t gross) at 10 m radius.
facts.fallControl: Each open bore is covered with a fixed, marked cover or fenced with a pile hole guard with a footplate as soon as the auger is withdrawn.

steps: Lift, pitch and lower reinforcement cages

swms.title: Secant pile retention wall and staged excavation
swms.task: Install the secant pile retention wall around the basement with the CFA piling rig, then excavate in stages in front of the wall to the 3 basement levels, next to the neighbouring buildings and the street.

facts.pilingPlatform: The working platform is designed by the project geotechnical engineer for the 90 t CFA rig and the 100 t bored pile rig, with a maximum plant loading of 250 kPa. The platform certificate is given to each rig operator before the rig goes on it.
facts.temporarySupport: The secant wall and its temporary props are to the engineer's design (drawing ____, revision ____), with each excavation stage approved by the engineer before it starts.
facts.fallControl: Edge protection is installed along the top of the retention wall before excavation goes below 2 m, and no one works outside it.

steps: Excavate in front of the retention wall

swms.title: Pile trimming
swms.task: Break down the pile heads to cut-off level with hydraulic pile croppers and breakers, in the basement.

facts.silicaControls: Pile heads are broken with hydraulic pile croppers and water suppression. Fit tested P2 respirators are worn while breaking. The written silica assessment is done before work starts and attached to this SWMS.
